brief:
Israeli forces shot four Palestinians on Sunday in Al-Mughayyir, a village northeast of Ramallah in the central West Bank, according to IMEMC News. The military personnel were stationed to provide security as a group of settlers entered the village. The shooting resulted in injuries to multiple Palestinians beyond those who were shot.

Media sources reported that colonizers had stormed into Al-Mughayyir as part of what appeared to be a coordinated operation. Israeli soldiers accompanied the settlers throughout the incursion, maintaining a protective presence during the episode that left residents wounded.
